## **Best move:** Qe1+

**Main line:** Qe1+ Rxe1 Rxe1#

**Motif:** Intermezzo, attraction

**Coaching Note:**

Your rook on e8 is attacked and looks lost, but don't panic—give check first! **Qe1+** forces White's rook to capture your queen. After Rxe1, your rook recaptures with checkmate on e1 because White's king has no escape squares on the back rank. The lesson: when your piece is hanging and the opponent's king is exposed, look for forcing moves (checks, captures, threats) before accepting material loss. An in-between check often turns a bad position into a winning one.
